 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes** why the room is silent, emphasizing its distance from other active parts of the house.**
 
• The **appropriate word** should reflect distance or separation.
 
• "**Remote**" fits well as it indicates distance, aligning with the context of the room being silent because of its location.

Therefore, the correct sentence from the passage should read **"****This room was chill, because it seldom had a fire; it was silent, because remote from the nursery and kitchen; solemn,...................."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Other options ("foreign", "strange") do not fit the context as well.

 
• **Foreign **(विदेशी): ""Foreign"" means from another country or unfamiliar, which does not fit the context of discussing the room's silence due to its location.
 
• **Strange** (अजीब): ""Strange"" indicates something unusual or unfamiliar, which does not align with describing the room's silence because of its distance from the nursery and kitchen.
